labs.research_summary: A Boston College research center founded in 1970 that studied wealth, philanthropy and motivations for giving; its page now describes it in the past tense.
labs.notes: The page uses past tense ('was a multidisciplinary research center'), so the Center appears no longer active. It names Paul G. Schervish, Professor Emeritus (paul.schervish@bc.edu), as a contact for his CV and papers, but does not say he leads the Center, so no lead is recorded. No people, join or contact pages. The worklist people page was a generic BC page.

notes: Only the start page was relevant; the worklist people page is a generic BC faculty and staff resource page.
